sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_contact_records" ("contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "questionnaire_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_submitted_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_detail" TEXT NULL, "location_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "place_name" TEXT NULL, "smallest_region_id" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, "reach_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interest_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lifecycle_status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("contact_id"), CHECK ((location_kind = 'resolved' AND place_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(place_name)) > 0 AND smallest_region_id IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(smallest_region_id)) > 0) OR (location_kind = 'not_applicable' AND place_name IS NULL AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL AND location_accuracy_meters IS NULL) OR (location_kind = 'pending_resolution' AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND (location_accuracy_meters IS NULL OR location_accuracy_meters >= 0))), CHECK (lifecycle_status IN ('active', 'voided')), CHECK (reach_count > 0), CHECK (interest_level BETWEEN 0 AND 4), CHECK (current_revision > 0), CHECK (channel IN ('face_to_face', 'voice_call', 'video_call', 'instant_text', 'asynchronous_message', 'mixed', 'other_direct')), CHECK (channel != 'other_direct' OR (channel_detail IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(channel_detail)) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_sync_outbox" ("command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "command_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lease_owner" TEXT NULL, "lease_expires_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "last_failure_code" TEXT NULL, "completed_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("command_id"), CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'leased', 'needs_resolution', 'permanent_failure', 'completed')), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), CHECK (protocol_version > 0 AND base_revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_contact_revisions" ("revision_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES db_contact_records (contact_id), "revision_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revised_by_app_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revised_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_detail" TEXT NULL, "location_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "place_name" TEXT NULL, "smallest_region_id" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, "reach_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interest_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("revision_id"), UNIQUE ("contact_id", "revision_number"), CHECK (revision_number > 0), CHECK (reach_count > 0), CHECK (interest_level BETWEEN 0 AND 4), CHECK ((location_kind = 'resolved' AND place_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(place_name)) > 0 AND smallest_region_id IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(smallest_region_id)) > 0) OR (location_kind = 'not_applicable' AND place_name IS NULL AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL AND location_accuracy_meters IS NULL) OR (location_kind = 'pending_resolution' AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND (location_accuracy_meters IS NULL OR location_accuracy_meters >= 0))), CHECK (channel IN ('face_to_face', 'voice_call', 'video_call', 'instant_text', 'asynchronous_message', 'mixed', 'other_direct')), CHECK (channel != 'other_direct' OR (channel_detail IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(channel_detail)) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_contact_answers" ("contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES db_contact_records (contact_id), "revision_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "boolean_value" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("boolean_value" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("contact_id", "revision_number", "question_id"), CHECK (revision_number > 0), CHECK (length(trim(question_id)) > 0), CHECK (answer_type = 'boolean' AND ((answer_state = 'answered' AND boolean_value IS NOT NULL) OR (answer_state IN ('unknown', 'refused', 'not_applicable', 'unanswered') AND boolean_value IS NULL))));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_contact_drafts" ("draft_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "questionnaire_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "occurred_time_zone" TEXT NULL, "channel" TEXT NULL, "channel_detail" TEXT NULL, "location_kind" TEXT NULL, "place_name" TEXT NULL, "smallest_region_id" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, "reach_count" INTEGER NULL, "interest_level" INTEGER NULL, "sync_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'account_private', "abandoned_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "undo_until_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("draft_id"), CHECK (length(trim(app_user_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(workspace_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(project_id)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(questionnaire_version_id)) > 0), CHECK (updated_at_utc >= created_at_utc), CHECK ((occurred_at_utc IS NULL AND occurred_time_zone IS NULL) OR (occurred_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND occurred_time_zone IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(occurred_time_zone)) > 0)), CHECK (channel IS NULL OR channel IN ('face_to_face', 'voice_call', 'video_call', 'instant_text', 'asynchronous_message', 'mixed', 'other_direct')), CHECK ((location_kind IS NULL AND place_name IS NULL AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL AND location_accuracy_meters IS NULL) OR (location_kind = 'resolved' AND place_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(place_name)) > 0 AND smallest_region_id IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(smallest_region_id)) > 0 AND latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL AND location_accuracy_meters IS NULL) OR (location_kind = 'not_applicable' AND place_name IS NULL AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude IS NULL AND longitude IS NULL AND location_accuracy_meters IS NULL) OR (location_kind = 'pending_resolution' AND place_name IS NULL AND smallest_region_id IS NULL AND latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND (location_accuracy_meters IS NULL OR location_accuracy_meters >= 0))), CHECK (reach_count IS NULL OR NULL) OR (abandoned_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND undo_until_utc IS NOT NULL AND undo_until_utc >= abandoned_at_utc)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_contact_draft_answers" ("draft_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES db_contact_drafts (draft_id), "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "boolean_value" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("boolean_value" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("draft_id", "question_id"), CHECK (length(trim(question_id)) > 0), CHECK (answer_type = 'boolean' AND ((answer_state = 'answered' AND boolean_value IS NOT NULL) OR (answer_state IN ('unknown', 'refused', 'not_applicable', 'unanswered') AND boolean_value IS NULL))));
CREATE INDEX contact_drafts_owner_updated ON db_contact_drafts (app_user_id, abandoned_at_utc, updated_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX contact_records_personal_period ON db_contact_records (app_user_id, workspace_id, project_id, occurred_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX sync_outbox_ready ON db_sync_outbox (status, next_attempt_at_utc, created_at_utc)
CREATE INDEX sync_outbox_aggregate_order ON db_sync_outbox (aggregate_id, created_at_utc)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_users" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "birthday" INTEGER NULL, "gender" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "occupation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contact_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "role_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "city_names_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_md5" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "failed_login_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "must_change_password" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("must_change_password" IN (0, 1)), "locked_until" INTEGER NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_failed_login_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_conversation_records" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "collector_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "city_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "area_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unassigned', "team_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorder_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "english_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "average_heart_rate" REAL NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "location_accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, "location_error" TEXT NULL, "manual_place_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gender" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity" TEXT NOT NULL, "age_range" TEXT NOT NULL, "relationship_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "interest_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "attitude_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_location_verified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_location_verified" IN (0, 1)), "corrected_latitude" REAL NULL, "corrected_longitude" REAL NULL, "corrected_place_name" TEXT NULL, "corrected_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_record_contacts" ("contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("contact_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "db_security_events" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_detail_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"));
